title: Elysia live cursor presence
context: Shared-document cursor presence over Elysia WebSockets. verifyToken(token) resolves to { userId } or null; canRead(userId, docId) resolves to a boolean, and only readers may join. On join a client receives the cursors of that document only. Each connection may publish at most 20 updates per second. All per-connection state must be dropped on close.
code: type Cursor = { docId: string; userId: string; x: number; y: number };
body: t.Object({ x: t.Number({ minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }), y: t.Number({ minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }) }),
cursors.set(ws.id, { docId, userId: session.userId, x: 0, y: 0 });

expected.why: arguments are swapped (canRead takes userId, docId), so the permission check tests the wrong pair
assignment instead of comparison: every cursor passes the filter and has its docId overwritten, leaking other documents' cursors
the lastSent entry is never removed, so the map grows with every connection ever made
